cells.gaps: No source found says how users sign in to Irembo, whether by the national ID or by one account shared across ministries.
cells.note: The ICT ministry says citizens submitted over 5 million applications through Irembo in 2023 and 2024 (RWA-009), and the minister put its services at 240 in November 2025 (RWA-008). A published count of applications meets stage 5, and a later yes answers the earlier questions.
